title: Saved text and recovery records from practice session C

context.question: Which transformation fits the stated goal, and what recovery claim does the supplied evidence support?

artifacts.transforms.txt:

FICTIONAL RECEIPTS: no encryption or restore was performed. No ciphertext or secret keys are shipped. Key IDs identify dependencies, not key material. Ciphertext checks are supplied statements. The helper hashes only the included dummy source/restored text.

K2 gold-v1: available; recovery operator access is allowed.
K3 grey-v1: availability and access have not been established.
artifacts.restore-ledger.txt:
